evidence.title: GitHub - uixmat/onborda: An onboarding wizard flow / product tour for Next.js animated by framer motion

name: Onborda
summary: Lightweight onboarding and product tour flow for Next.js, animated with Framer Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS.
description: Onborda renders guided product tours and onboarding wizards in Next.js apps: you define tours and steps, target any element by its id attribute and show fully customisable pointer tooltips with Framer Motion transitions. The tour card can be replaced with a custom component, and hooks and options control behaviour; styling works with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
contains: product tours with multiple steps targeting elements by id
fully customisable pointer tooltips; custom card component supported
framer-motion animations, Tailwind CSS styling, Radix portal
